qualification: independent Robotron K7222.25 operating comparator naming the AE9VT yoke family; not a K7222.11 T3 pin map, winding specification or installed setting

online_text_counterpart.note: The public copy has the corresponding printed pages 25 and 85, but is not byte-identical to the locally rendered scan.

horizontal_stage_k7222_25.boost_voltage_reference: across C21, rather than boost node to chassis ground
horizontal_stage_k7222_25.tap_function: Selects horizontal deflection voltage for limit-case yoke coils; the adjustable 41P rail otherwise sets horizontal amplitude.
horizontal_stage_k7222_25.l1_l2_function: Additional filtering of 41P for other stages in this revision; these are not the K7222.11 page-9 centering chokes.

excluded_transfer: The preceding non-.25 paragraph gives a 110 uH yoke and 18 V boost; it does not describe the explicitly marked K7222.25 stage.
The manual gives no AE9VT inductance, resistance, current sensitivity or axial field profile.
Tap numbers 2, 3 and 4 establish a function in K7222.25 but do not assign K7222.11 X1/X2 terminals, tap order or turns.
The 60-70 V boost is a cross-revision operating comparator, not a measurement of K7222.11.
